title: Interleukin23 in Systemic Lupus
off: Role of Interleukin 23 in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Related Interstial Lung Disease
conds: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Related Interstial Lung Disease
summary: assement of interleukin 23 in serum of patients with systemic lupus erythematosus related interstial lung disease .
desc: for all patients detailed history taken clinical and rhumatological examination will be assessed and SLEDAI score will be collected from the case record of the patients\&laboratory investigation included 1\_erythrocytic sedimentation rate.2\_complete blood count.3\_interleukin23 .4\_complement 3\&4.5\_Antinuclear Antibodies.6\_Anti double stranded antibodies.7\_full basic biochemical test(24 urine protien)8\_high resolution computed tomography.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with systemic lupus erythematous and patients with systemic lupus erythematosus with interstial lung disease.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with chest conditions rather than interstial lung disease \&who receiving biological blocking antibodies\& those treated with immunosuppressive drugs.

arms.d: Patients with systemic lupus erythematosus without interstial lung disease.
Patients with systemic lupus erythematosus with interstial lung disease.
